record_title: A universal self-similar degeneration rate for largest-dihedral-angle bisection
provenance: Asymptotic dynamical analysis of the exact invariant largest-dihedral-angle-bisection recurrence introduced in arXiv:2609.18788.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to the explicit invariant LAB family with fixed base-ray angle and does not establish attraction in the full tetrahedral shape space or repair the degenerating refinement rule.
